summary: Full backend + frontend test of the NEW plan-reader layer over the untouched NBC Part 4 engine. Backend: 13/14 pytest cases pass (/api/plan/status, /api/plan/extract with synthetic fixture, DWG graceful degradation, /api/plan/placement with and without planId, /api/analyze-mixed, /api/occupancies, /api/reports/compliance.pdf). Frontend: home entry-mode choice, full upload->review->confirm->results flow with Plan Reference, Equipment Quantities and Equipment Placement (SVG overlay, side table, legend, zoom) all verified; Manual Entry regression confirmed clean (no plan-only sections). Only failure is a PRE-EXISTING crash in /api/analyze-manual inside the unmodified engine (not caused by this build).

critical.issue: PRE-EXISTING (engine, not new layer): every payload returns 400 'Invalid input...'. Real cause is AttributeError at engines/standards_engine.py:64 -> nbc.firefighting_installations where code_findings['nbc_compliance'] is None; the traceback is swallowed by the broad except in routes/analyze_manual.py and reported as a 400. This endpoint is still used by frontend/src/app/confirm/page.tsx, so the confirm flow is dead.

minor.issue: planReference returns duplicate keys 'odps_inward_no' and 'inward_no' with the identical value (ODPS/2023/014577); the panel renders the same row twice.

Sprinkler quantity inconsistency between sections: quantities table reports 392 heads (engine, ~56/floor) while the plan overlay/side table places only 12 heads on the Ground Floor block with no note explaining that the overlay grid is limited to the detected floor-plan block.

ui_bugs.issue: React console error on every /results render: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' — appears on both upload and manual flows.

issues: Default zoom does not fit the sheet to the viewport: rendered image is ~842px wide inside a ~600px column, so the plan (title block text) is clipped on both sides and the user must pan immediately. A fit-to-width initial scale would be better.
Placement markers are tiny relative to the whole-sheet render; consider auto-zooming to the detected floor-plan block.

action_items: Fix /api/analyze-manual: guard nbc_compliance None in engines/standards_engine.py caller path (or stop /confirm from calling it) — currently a hard failure for any payload. NOTE: engine file change may be out of scope; the safe alternative is to route /confirm to /api/analyze-mixed.
De-duplicate planReference keys (odps_inward_no vs inward_no) in plan_reader/table_parser.py Type-3 parsing.
Add a note/label reconciling the engine sprinkler total with the number of heads drawn on the single-floor overlay.
Fix missing React list key in results/page.tsx.
Make PlanViewer initial scale fit-to-container so the plan is not clipped on load.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/analyze_manual.py swallows all exceptions into a generic 400 — real 500-class bugs (like the current AttributeError) are masked; return 500 with the error class or log-and-reraise.

routes/plan.py: doc.close() is called before doc.original_format is read in the success response (works today only because original_format is a plain attribute) — read all needed attributes before close.
plan_reader/store.py in-memory plan store means placement silently degrades after a backend reload; the graceful 'session expired' path exists and works, but consider TTL/size caps documented.
/api/plan/extract returns a full base64 page image inline (large payload); consider a separate image endpoint to keep the review JSON small.

success_rate.backend: 93% (13/14; the single failure is pre-existing and outside this build)

seed_data_creation: Used existing fixture /app/backend/tests/_synthetic_plan.pdf. Test analyses named TEST_Synthetic / TEST_Manual; no persistence, nothing to clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite is /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: /root/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py from /app/backend). Verified: extract prefill (plotArea 1200, builtUp 3060, 7 floors, 22.5 m, A-4, kitchen+sprinkler true), tablesFound all true, geometryAvailable true, ODPS/2019/004102 earlier-approved case, DWG -> extractionPath dwg_unsupported (200), placement without planId -> available:false + quantities, full placement -> points(extinguisher/hose_reel/sprinkler/riser) + riser&ring pipes + calibration 1:100 ptPerM 28.35 + sanity.ok + correct 'Per NBC Part 4 calculation' vs 'Estimated per ...' labels. Frontend verified end-to-end on the public URL; manual flow correctly clears sessionStorage 'firerulx_plan' at analyze time (note: it is NOT cleared on /manual page load, only right before navigation — sections still absent, so behaviour is fine). Do not attempt to fix the 13 pre-existing test_rule_engine.py failures.
rca_of_the_issue: /api/analyze-manual: rule_engine.run_rule_engine -> standards_engine.evaluate accesses code_findings['nbc_compliance'].firefighting_installations; the key exists but the value is None for these inputs, raising AttributeError which routes/analyze_manual.py converts to a misleading 400 'Invalid input'. Reproduce: POST any BuildingInput (e.g. {buildingName,buildingType:'A-4',totalFloorArea:1500,numberOfFloors:3,floorAreas:[500,500,500],buildingHeight:20}) to /api/analyze-manual. Confirmed pre-existing: git diff shows no changes to rule_engine.py/engines/*.
